newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korean defector said to arrive in Seoul by Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: N.Korean defector said to arrive in Seoul by Tuesday.

text.p: A high-level North Korean defector taking refuge in the Philippines will arrive in South Korea by Tuesday, a senior Seoul foreign ministry official said.

Hwang Jang-yop, the most senior Pyongyang official ever to flee the communist country, would arrive between Sunday and Tuesday, the official told Reuters on Thursday. Hwang has been in the Philippines since March 18 after arriving there via Beijing.
"Mr Hwang Jang-yop will be flown to our country between April 20-22," the official said, asking not to be identified.

Hwang, chief architect of North Korea's ideology of "juche", a creed of self-reliance, went to South Korea's consulate in Beijing on February 12 and had to wait for more than a month before he was spirited out to the Philippines.
South Korean information officials have told reporters they are arranging facilities for the media, including foreign journalists, to cover Hwang's arrival.
North and South Korea are still locked in confrontation more than four decades after the end of the 1950-53 Korean War.
